name: JW Marriott Starr Pass Resort and Spa
insider_take: This desert oasis sits on 600 acres at the foot of the Tucson Mountains, where luxury meets the untamed beauty of the Sonoran Desert.
whats_special: The resort features the only 27-hole championship golf course designed by Arnold Palmer in Southern Arizona, plus Arizona's largest resort spa at 20,000 square feet. The property showcases authentic Southwestern architecture with hand-painted tiles and locally-sourced materials, while offering unobstructed views of saguaro cacti that can live over 200 years.
pro_tip: Book spa treatments during sunset hours - the floor-to-ceiling windows offer stunning desert vistas as the mountains glow pink and orange, a phenomenon locals call "alpenglow."
dont_miss: The nearby Saguaro National Park West entrance is just 10 minutes away, home to the largest cacti in the US. Visit the resort's stargazing experiences - Tucson is a UNESCO City of Gastronomy and International Dark Sky Place, offering some of the clearest night skies in America.
pros: Stunning desert mountain views and scenic Sonoran Desert location
Championship golf course and comprehensive spa facilities
Multiple pools including adults-only and family-friendly options
Spacious rooms and suites with luxury amenities
cons: Resort location requires transportation to downtown Tucson attractions
Premium pricing for resort amenities and dining
